SampleWelcomeBody:
My Stickies keeps your notes at the right edge of your screen.

- Hover over the bookmark at the right edge to reveal your notes
- Hover over a note to read it
- Click a note to edit it
- Move the pointer away to fold the deck

You can delete these welcome notes after reading them.
SampleEditingBody:
- Click the title or body to edit that part of the note
- Enter in the title: move to the body
- Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+S: save and finish editing
- Esc: discard changes
- Clicking outside also saves your changes
- An empty title becomes "New note (date and time)"

Global shortcuts
- Ctrl+Alt+S: show or fold the deck
- Ctrl+Alt+N: create and edit a new note
SampleOrganizingBody:
- + below the deck: add a note
- Pin at the top right: keep a floating note above other apps; drag the left strip to move it
- Pin again: return the note to the deck
- − at the top right: hide the note without deleting it
- × at the top right: delete; click again to confirm
- Color dots while editing: change the note color
- Drag notes up or down to reorder them

The deck shows only your most recent notes. Open All notes from the tray menu or the bookmark’s right-click menu to search, restore, export, and import notes. Pinned notes and their positions are restored when you restart the app.
SampleSettingsBody:
Right-click the tray icon and choose Settings to change:

- Language: Korean or English
- Notes folder: choose a synced folder such as Synology Drive to share notes across your PCs
- Dock monitor, visible note count, vertical position, and collapse delay
- Font and body text size
- Fullscreen hiding and global shortcuts
- Automatic startup at Windows sign-in
